text: {"blocks": [{"kind": "paragraph", "md": "It changes, and in the masculine it's the one change worth memorizing: **mein** Bruder becomes **meinen** Bruder when he's the object — *Ich sehe meinen Bruder.*"}, {"kind": "list", "style": "bullet", "items": ["masculine: mein Bruder → **meinen** Bruder", "feminine: meine Schwester → meine Schwester (no change)", "neuter: mein Kind → mein Kind (no change)", "plural: meine Eltern → meine Eltern (no change)"]}, {"kind": "mcq", "id": "q-akk-check", "prompt": "*Ich besuche ___ Vater.*", "options": [{"id": "a", "label": "mein"}, {"id": "b", "label": "meinen"}, {"id": "c", "label": "meine"}], "correctId": "b", "explain": "Vater is masculine and he's being visited, so it takes the -en."}]}
